lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jorge Bennett is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Jorge is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d42: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d42: 🕯️ Jorge Bennett is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Jorge kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Jorge's gone." Cameron looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jorge." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Pamela blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.

d42: 📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.

d42: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Jorge's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jorge Bennett, 42 days. The mantle passes to Pamela Dixon.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Pamela Dixon, 46 — a hunting guide. Her hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Echo Location, War Cry, Dowsing, Green Whisper.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Jorge — and Jorge is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Liam, Cameron, Arif and 6 more speak for Pamela — "Jorge trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Pamela before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
